FAQs

Is a quotation the same as an invoice?

No. A quotation is shared before work or sale approval. An invoice requests payment after work or sale.

Can I create estimates too?

Yes. The same structure works for estimates and quotes.

Can I convert a quote to invoice?

This workflow is planned as part of InvoiceWala's finance document system.
